metadata.description: An explicit edge to dbx-cli:build-base, NOT `^build`. This entry point compiles into the parent's dist directory, which `dbx-cli:build-base` deletes and rewrites (rollup `deleteOutputPath: true`), so it cannot run before the parent -- but the edge has to be spelled out, because `^build` here would resolve to dbx-cli:build, which depends on this very target: a hard cycle. Either the children get `^build` or the parent aggregates them, never both; aggregating keeps one writer per dist directory.  It imports only the parent's own `src/lib/docs` sources (relative), so it needs no sibling edge.
